method_notes: Schedule IDs and stats API season IDs are separate namespaces.
Confirmed regular-season schedule IDs: 1 (2022/23), 8 (2023/24), 19 (2024/25); schedule 36 is sampled 2025/26, and schedule 57 is current 2026/27.

A coarse read-only survey of 3,920 schedule/matchday pairs (schedule IDs 1–49; 80 sampled matchday IDs across 1–1,581) found NBA-like records only under schedules 1, 3, 8, 19 and 36. Schedule 3 sample is playoffs; 1/8/19/36 map to 2022/23–2025/26. No earlier regular season was found, but the sample is not exhaustive.
For 2022/23, 1,041 official records include 1,040 played and one postponed DET–WAS record. Excluding the postponed record, all 2,080 team sides and validity flags match.
For 2023/24, all 2,028 team sides from 1,014 played games match; 2,027/2,028 validity flags agree. The only mismatch is BOS–CLE on 2023-12-12.

Cross-endpoint BOS–CLE check: schedule-level is_valid is true/false; six sampled player-games API records (three per team) and local archive rows have gameValidForDunkest=false. Do not treat these fields as interchangeable or rewrite the raw values.
For 2024/25, 1,040 official records include 1,037 played, one stale playing status present in the archive, and two postponed. All 2,076 archive-backed team sides and validity flags match.
No raw data, official PDK targets, model, temporal splits, or backtests were modified.

status_aware_validation.remaining_mismatch: BOS–CLE, 2023-12-12; schedule API home_valid=true, away_valid=false; six sampled player-games API records and all local player rows have gameValidForDunkest=false.

coarse_historical_survey.interpretation: No pre-2022/23 NBA regular-season calendar found in the sample; this does not prove historical schedules do not exist.
